paper_metadata.title: Achieving high strength and ductility in nitrogen-doped refractory high-entropy alloys

evidence.quote: Refractory high-entropy alloys (HEAs) usually exhibit high strength but limited ductility. Here, we report high strength ( /C24 1334 MPa) and large ductility ( /C24 18.8%) in nitrogen-doped TiZrNbTa HEAs.
